notes.title: Game Update | 1.25.05.30:4047
notes.notes:
Drag System - Core Update
We've overhauled the fishing drag system and how equipment handles overload during fights:

The fish now pulls the line only when the pulling force exceeds the reel's brake setting, calculated as MaxKgReel * Drag. Previously, line tension was triggered as long as the drag was set below 100%, without considering the reel’s actual strength in kilograms.
 Equipment damage has also been improved: now, the weakest component (rod, reel, or line) will always break first. Previously, if two or more parts were overloaded simultaneously, one of them could fail, regardless of its strength rating.
We've also updated the calculation of rod bending force. Just like with damage, it now respects the reel’s true strength (MaxKgReel * Drag), not just a percentage-based drag factor. This should result in more realistic and skill-based fishing mechanics.
As always, we tested this on our end, but every player has a different feeling about drag & fish fights. If you want to share your feedback, we will read it with pleasure.

Christmas Event 2023
The event is the same as last year and there are two reasons for that. First, we are digging in the code and project to push the NEW FIsh System on public beta ASAP, as this is right now a game-breaking issue when it comes to catching big fish. Second - a lot of players didn't know about last year's event, so we are giving just the same tasks, and rewards as last year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/497e04f4688fbe3e825f218cf4bafeae3c3888a8.jpg

New Save System
So it is here finally, the proper Steam Cloud support and syncing all your saves between different machines. It was done from scratches, saves that were saved in the Windows registry have been fully moved to AppData by re-working the whole system how data is stored and saved from the game.

New Audio System (partially)
So, the old audio system was messed up a lot and while doing this we found out that many sounds that were implemented in the game didn't even "play" in the game. It's not perfect right now but the current system allows us to implement a lot of sound options and configurations with channels, 3D audio/spatial, etc. We will improve this system but from main things that you should notice are: new reeling sound, new casting sound, new lodge sounds, and some new environment sounds. 

SLOVAKIA 2.0
You will probably ask WHY? And the answer is: FLY FISHING. As the development is moving forward we are slowly preparing to do fly fishing mechanics and we need maps that will allow you to enjoy it to its full potential. Slovakia was supposed to be a mountain river with a proper river current (that is still in the works). So the map was I would say re-done in 90%. notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!
It's been a while, and we are bringing the first public beta update today. It contains a few more things than we told such as sandbox mode and the new Slovakia map version. So if you are interested in what changed in detail I will describe it later but first, let me guide you on how to activate BETA on Steam. Remember to join our Discord: https://discord.gg/5AnMchrWYZ

Caution: Beta can be unstable, there can be bugs that are not present on the normal version :)

BETA Feedback forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1136380/discussions/7/

 PUBLIC BETA | HOW TO PLAY? [olist]
 Right-click on the game from the library page and select "Properties".
 Click on the "BETAS" tab.
 Select from the dropdown list “public beta”
 Press OK.[/olist]Important: As this is Save System beta, we needed to make sure that YOU won't lose your progress. So FIRST time you launch BETA, you will see an admin prompt from Windows, as we are doing a backup from your registry. It is done with a simple .bat file script, you can check what this script contains > HERE  HERE <).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/bb1b75825ab581026fd9c8d27706973dc6ef336d.png

Important: Progress made on BETA doesn't transfer to the NORMAL account. 

New Audio System
So, the old audio system was messed up a lot and while doing this we found out that many sounds that were implemented in the game didn't even "play" in the game. It's not perfect right now but the current system allows us to implement a lot of sound options and configurations with channels, 3D audio/spatial, etc. We will improve this system but from main things that you should notice are: new reeling sound, new casting sound, new lodge sounds, and some new environment sounds. 

In the future, we want to also change all environment sounds to fit the proper theme and unique fauna on each map but that's something we will address in the later stage. 

SANDBOX MODE
It is finally here. Everything is unlocked, all equipment, all maps, and no level limitations. But you need to remember: sandbox is based on the "normal" mode. In the future we plan to add more options to the sandbox to allow you to change the bait ratios, fight lengths, stamina boosts, etc. - so you can adjust the game to your style of gameplay. 

Also, on Sandbox tournaments are disabled. 

SLOVAKIA 2.0
You will probably ask WHY? And the answer is: FLY FISHING. As the development is moving forward we are slowly preparing to do fly fishing mechanics and we need maps that will allow you to enjoy it to its full potential. Slovakia was supposed to be a mountain river with a proper river current (that is still in the works). So the map was I would say re-done in 90%. notes.title: Status Update | Current Development & Issues
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
I would like to make a short summary of the latest update and talk a bit about what will come next. But first of all, we should talk about current problems in the gameplay. Just to remind you right now we are digging into messed code after the fired programmer left us without any documentation and desire to help (sic!). But more about the current situation later.

Big fish
For the last months, players have been unable to catch big fish as their max. the size was limited to 80kg and then to something around 200 kg. In one of the latest updates we removed those limits and now all fish can reach their max weight on the map. That means monsters are swimming in the waters and they caused many problems. Right now maximum fish weight in UFS2 is 1250kg for Beluga, 810kg for Tiger Shark, 390kg for European Sea Sturgeon, 450kg for Gian Grouper, and more.

But it seems big fish have stamina problems which can be serious gameplay-breaking issues at higher levels. Sooo….

Believe us or not - it was sometimes a fun thing to mess with fish scale/size. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/7a43cd58cf28bde3c052fa33b661e51a74541950.png

The fish stamina system is broken 
Yes. It is and it is directly correlated to fish weights. We have been investigating this issue for the last few days and we just couldn't even tweak the current code as once big fish stamina is somehow correlated with their weight…so fish with stamina that is around 0% doesn’t even bend the rod as the system shows it as 0 kg. So fish fly all around if you only try to reel it in or pump the rod… and we just couldn’t do it.

So going further – the current system of fish stamina needs to be done from scratches and we already have a calculator for us which will determine how long the player will have to fight with the biggest fish to keep the fun and enjoyment of catching them. Once it will be done right with 1250kg Beluga, with reel drag 90kg (80-90%) should take no longer than 15 minutes, and right now it takes…hours (we are still stunned that someone is so motivated to reel in fish for few hours, we should give you special awards/achievements for that). 

This is a serious issue that we are aware of and hopefully, we will be able to replace the current code with our own without breaking the game.

Fish speed & fight
Another issue was that fish during a fight are just standing in one place and they just act like a rock, not fish. Yesterday we figured out how to tweak it. It was a bit tricky but we found a way to do it properly. Fish now moves as they are supposed to from left to right, up and down, and require you to follow them and keep proper line tension…but it seems we did them a bit too fast. And yes – we have been testing it, the whole team but it just felt good for us for example none of us had issues but that is why UFS2 is available in Early Access. 

[previewyoutube=tqeJ0jMhJv0;full][/previewyoutube]

Ah, also – fish swimming animations and other will be improved in a short time. 

Lures and fish size issue
Yes, it is still an issue but we did many tweaks in the current system and it won’t be good till we will rework it. I don’t know if any of the players noticed but spinning lures don’t have treble/jig head size we will fix that together with the new lures system but that’s not all. We have a few solutions here for players and I will list them below:
 New lures system that is based on hooks/trebles/jig head sizes
 New popup information that shows information about your hook not matching fish in the area you cast the rod
 Add new information in the equipment/store about the fish weight range that can be caught on specific lures & hook size
And in the later stage:
 Lures are affected by weather and time of day
 Lures that have different ATTRACTIVENESS for each fish specie
 Lures that behave properly (fixed animations and physics – that may take more time than the above two points)
 Lures having hooks/treble/jighead size number
 Color affecting ATTRACTIVENESS
If everything will go according to our plan, we should release such an update in February.

Float / Feeder
These two methods are in the shadow of spinning right now and we would like to change them. This one will require a lot of work and adjustments in fish AI, so it will be used just like in real life.
The amount of equipment for this method is also low without missing features that has been announced some time ago (ex. ground baits), and we are still aiming for doing all things in RoadMap – it will be just a bit later.

Fish Behavior
As we all know right now you can catch almost any fish on spinning including the famous Beluga, Carp, and others. We will re-work this system completely and fish species that are typically for feeders/floats will be like this in UFS2 too. So rework should include:
 Bottom fish/herbivore/omnivore being catchable in 95% of situations on natural baits not spinning.
 Each natural bait will have different ATTRACTIVENESS for each fish specie
 Bottom fish will be really bottom fish
Russia is BROKEN! NO FISH! 
Yes, it was an issue earlier and it was directly related to the lure's size and fish zones. Yesterday we did an update, where we changed fish zones and add 5 new fish species to the map. It should be more alive now but in general Kurile, Lake map contains a lot of Trout/Salmon species that are above 20 kg, so high-level lures didn’t attract them. 

Fix Steam Cloud & Saves
We will. It's one of the most important fix on our list but it needs a full overhaul of the current save system. 

Do we test what we release? 
We do, but we are 5 people that need to handle messed code after the old programmer. You can see that we do updates on different branches and test them before release. You can check these things publicly here: https://steamdb.info/app/1136380/depots/ 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/4f5def03976ee8dd2ef5e6f008b846ea20120444.png

Major Updates
Right now our new programmer is not working on the same build as we are, as he is handling the whole code that needs to be rewritten so every game update and every game feature will be easy to implement in the future without messing in X additional files.

By that I also mean that we are aiming to move to a new version of Unity 2021 LTS, supporting HDRP. But I don’t know when it will happen as having a clear & functional code is the most important thing right now. Once we will have this – we will move to the new Unity and will start implementing all roadmap features one by one. 

Early-Access
We do know that some factors like big fish are just game-breaking issues right now and we are doing our best to fix things one by one sometimes working 16 hours per day. Digging, searching, and testing all changes, as even a change of 1 number can right now break the whole fish behavior or other aspects. So even if we will test everything on our side, we can miss some scenarios or something may just not be present on our side – that is why we decided for early access. 

Steam Early Access means that the game is still being developed, and should be considered "unfinished" or even a “beta” version of the game. You can read more about it in the Steam FAQ: https://store.steampowered.com/earlyaccessfaq

Remember that even if we are not replying to some threads, we read them probably all of them, and collect as much data as we can – as this is the most valuable source of information for us. So, if you would like to help us by posting bugs in the forum remember to include information on how it happened or how we can reproduce such issues. A video or screenshot would be also useful. 
An issue with bug-reporting F5 (mouse-locked) will be fixed on Monday and this is the fastest way to let us know and include data about your issue. 

What we are currently working on? 
Besides all fixes, adjustments, and re-writing of the game, one of us is right now creating complete 3D avatars of players for multiplayer mode. It’s a different factor of development so it doesn’t affect current work on fixing the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/cdf29b36fcefa6c872cf60884f290034344f83c4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/fc065cf012ad0b067d9742c73f8ed013e6759f40.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/4d30695b11f7779053afb2a13d60364fa394904e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/2a386bbe1603dca0d919e369c540f0419d6d2a17.png

So…
That seems to be a “short” summary of the current status! If you have any questions just ask, and remember that we are here. It is a pretty mess for us but the current situation gives us a lot of lessons and we are on a good way to doing everything right – just like it should be since Day 1 of the Early Access release. 

We are really grateful for your support. You are a great community!

Regards,
Rafal & UFS2 Team

notes.title: [DevTalks #8] Map Reveal – Kiel Canal / Release information
notes.notes:
Hey Folks! 
We'll give you some interesting news today - unfortunately, not all of them will be positive.

A few words of introduction. We are coming to the end of 2021 - a really hard and busy year behind us. When you think that we planned to release the game at the beginning of 2021 - it was crazy! We're happy to have more time to polish our project, which needed a lot of polishing - and still does.

In 2021 we released a demo that could have been better. We've changed quite a few things since then including among others:  the water system (based on survey responses), weather, fish behavior, water effects, etc. 

We hope you will want to…

TAKE PART IN STEAM PLAYTEST

As we are not sure if the changes we made were good and players will enjoy them we will run Steam Playtest for about 1500 players. 

Everyone will be able to opt-in. I don’t know yet how we will approve player requests but we will just choose people from all opt-ins. Additionally, we will manually grant access to players that were active on our Steam forums :)

Additionally – there will be a HUGE survey and players who will complete it will take a part in the giveaway of:
 30x Ultimate Fishing Simulator 2 (Steam Key on Release)
 10x Ultimate Fishing Simulator Complete Edition (Steam Key)
We want to make sure that the game we develop was done properly. We won’t be able to satisfy everyone but we will do our best to listen to the community and do regular surveys about future updates. 

We will post a separate post when OPT-IN for Playtest will be open. 
You will be able to opt-in for a few weeks. Beta tests will start in January/February if everything will go as we plan. 

As a result, we officially announce that the game release is postponed to Q1 2022. Now, let's talk about the next map for UFS2 :)

Saltwater or freshwater? It’s KIEL CANAL

The Kiel Canal is an artificial waterway and a maritime waterway connecting the Baltic Sea (Kiel Bay) with the North Sea (Elbe estuary). In UFS 2 you are given a harbor waterfront that is pretty much urbanized!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/609e405bd3efbe3f2870321cf3f60f58dc13afac.jpg

This is an unusual or rather unique fishery. You will be able to catch both saltwater and freshwater fish here. And thanks to the fact that the channel is constantly kept clean, it is perfect for spinning or ground fishing. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/6f0ee83c39401740bd478878650a00d561177816.jpg

FISH SPECIES
At the time of writing this post, there are 10 different species of fish on the map. They are:
 European perch
 Asp
 Wels Catfish
 Zander
 Atlantic salmon
 Common sturgeon
 Sea trout
 Atlantic Cod
 European flounder
 Garfish


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/b20b5fca53869ab3b72b589ae911720c4b2f00f0.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/8b54cbe4d14c08458f135f4be84be5e205751024.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/287ed128326c39d4af758bf44c3a8e5e65a7aadf.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/2ffe1d8a0b90625a8def816c3e36ada9cc9cfff4.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/4a945bde1bbc6d44062d44b9526c7bf30ddd8ff6.jpg

But don't let the tranquility of this water fool you. Remember that this is an artificial channel and its banks are quite steep - that is why sometimes pulling out a big fish can be quite a challenge.

So who would like to go for a night fishing by lantern light?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/70111dc6936dd5d689ed41b60f2ccd1e8f1bc00a.jpg

Ps. If you think there should be other fish species on the map - let us know in the comments!

Regards,
Rafal
